{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders
qa_mask = df['revenue'] == 999999.99

# Filter out QA orders and refunded orders
filtered_df = df[~qa_mask & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Check customer segment distribution by channel
segment_by_channel = pd.crosstab(filtered_df['channel'], filtered_df['customer_segment'])
print("Customer segment distribution by channel:")
print(segment_by_channel)

# Compute average revenue per converted order, stratified by segment
# Only among converted orders
converted_only = filtered_df[filtered_df['converted'] == 1]
revenue_by_channel_segment = converted_only.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['revenue'].mean().unstack(level='customer_segment')
print("\nAverage revenue per converted order by channel and segment:")
print(revenue_by_channel_segment)

# Compute conversion rate by segment within channel
conversion_rate_by_channel_segment = converted_only.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().unstack(level='customer_segment')
print("\nConversion rate by channel and segment:")
print(conversion_rate_by_channel_segment)"}
